description: Header file defining ASN.1 structures for 3GPP RRC NR BCCH-DL-SCH-Message, including choice and sequence structures with serialization and JSON conversion methods.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the CHOICE type for BCCH-DL-SCH-Message, including nested choice for message content.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the SEQUENCE for BCCH-DL-SCH-Message, containing the message type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of the message or choice.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from bit stream.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the structure to JSON format.

methods.name: c1
methods.description: Accesses the 'c1' choice within the message type.
